_comment: Required visual roles and display states of the confirmed Q-D decisions (research/14 §3.3). Each item is verified by the checks that name it in tests/spec/runtime/*.json, or carries `unverified` with a reason and the risk. Step 1 lists only what the step-1 checks cover; later steps add items.

requirements.description: Centre editor background = Inkdrop editor background
Status bar background = Inkdrop note list background
Settings modal (a popout window in Obsidian 1.14.4) keeps the opaque editor background; guards against scoped rules leaking (research/13 §2.1.1)
